::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-head}
[September 2026]{.timeline-date} [UC activity manuscript, under review]{.timeline-title}
:::
::: {.timeline-desc}
Submitted the Bayesian multilevel manuscript on 27 September. The study combines MR enterography features with faecal calprotectin to estimate endoscopic activity in individual colonic segments, in a prospective cohort of 49 adults with UC and 245 segments. It is now under review. [Study page](work/studies/uc-mre-bayes/index.qmd).
:::
[UC MRE]{.timeline-tags}
:::

[June 2026]{.timeline-date} [Lineage module, stages 3 through 6 built]{.timeline-title}
:::
::: {.timeline-desc}
Reframed the pruner after similarity-based cuts failed to separate on-thread from off-thread papers. The distinction turned out to be structural and temporal, not topical. Stage 6 shipped as a two-step selection-plus-narration system with a strict anti-hallucination contract.
:::
[lineage]{.timeline-tags}
